row: The 6-Steps were created to give dog owners reliable and accurate information about their dogs ACL injury and how to treat it. By going through the 6-Steps you will learn about the anatomy of the dog knee, what the ACL is and why it sometimes tears in dogs, how to diagnose an ACL tear, what the treatment options are, what TPLO is, and the recovery process.
